references.text: Delilah's persistent pressure on Samson reminds us of his earlier experience with his wife from Timnah, who also wept and pressured him to reveal a secret.
Delilah accuses Samson of not loving her, setting the stage for her continued pressure in this verse.
The expression 'his soul was vexed' (וַתִּקְצַר נַפְשׁוֹ) is also used regarding the people of Israel when they became impatient and disheartened in the wilderness.
Job expresses a similar longing for death due to extreme suffering and pressure, as Samson experienced here.
Elijah asked to die because he was exhausted and disheartened, a condition similar to what Samson endured under Delilah's persistent pressure.
